sections.title: Reading — Task 1: Tasks
sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The chart below shows the number of travellers using three major airports in New York City between 1995 and 2000. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Nowadays people move from one country to another for work. Some people think children of these families suffer because of this while others thinks it is helpful for them. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
